title: The Treatise of Unbearable Weight
summary: A treatise on piling weight upon weight through the qi field until a single fall is more than anything beneath it can bear.

title: Canon of the Falling Titan
summary: A canon of the titan that falls with the Core's whole weight and levels the ground it falls upon.

title: The Worldbearer's Last Burden
summary: A canon of the bearer who carries more than a body can hold and sets the burden down in a single ruinous stroke.
